title: The ticket plan approves a proofs-only build
intention: A proofs-only build whose ticket plan names the proof file reads as approved by the plan itself, and the tester never opens an approval question in Akien's inbox.
why: Akien, F50 in ~/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md (2026-10-09), verbatim: 'tester should never ask me about anything that i don't need to have approved. the plan based tickets are inherently preapproved.' Under f5bba1daa72a (ruling 8p, 2026-10-06) a proofs-only build reads 'measured nothing' at PROVEME unless an answered question names the file, and --seal opens that question itself; 68e897fc74b8 and 017d8298662a would each put one in his inbox.
traces_to: Law 9 (Akien's head outranks the older translation, ruling 8p) and Akien's review bandwidth (his inbox is for vision coherence only); Akien, F50 in ~/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md (2026-10-09), verbatim: 'tester should never ask me about anything that i don't need to have approved. the plan based tickets are inherently preapproved.'
how: In cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py, approval() reads the ticket's plan (plan.json once the plan/log format lands; until then the ticket's writes_to/falsifier-named paths) and returns 'plan' when every skipped file is named there; cli.py's --seal stops calling ask_for_approval, and ask_for_approval retires. The standing approval proof is rewritten to F50.
falsifier: Done when, in a fixture commons through the tester's public CLI: (1) a proofs-only build whose ticket plan names the proof file reads green at --hollow and records the approval as the plan (no question id), and --seal opens NO question; (2) a proofs-only build that writes a proof file its plan does NOT name stays red ('measured nothing') and opens no question either — the red is the record; (3) a non-proofs-only empty run stays red as now. The standing proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_records_an_approved_proofs_only_build.py is rewritten to these clauses (its question-based approval retires with ruling 8p). Wrong intent if: a plan cannot name its proof files in a field the tester can read without parsing prose (then this waits on the plan/log format ticket).
watchme: none, because the measure is the questions corpus itself: CairnCommons/questions/ gains no question raised_by the tester after this ships
builder_notes: WHERE: cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py approval() :715 and ask_for_approval() :735; cairn/devices/tester/cli.py:160 (the --seal call). Build only after the plan/log format ticket lands: read the plan file's named proof paths through the ticket store's reader (never parse prose). approval() returns 'plan' when every skipped instrument file is named; the finding's approved map records {file: 'plan'}; ask_for_approval and the cli.py:160 call are removed. Rewrite cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_records_an_approved_proofs_only_build.py to clauses (1)-(3), fixture commons under scratch_dir, PROVES keyed to this ticket; keep test_the_hollow_skips_only_the_instrument.py tooth 3 (instrument-only, plan does not name it -> red).
ordered_after: the plan/log ticket format work (F49, not yet cast)
